title: Coffee for Cassius

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: You know if you drop something from one of the ledges here it falls right down and keeps falling?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know if you drop something from one of the ledges here it falls right down and keeps falling?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I'm hiding.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm hiding.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Life, the future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Life, the future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: How do elevators work? Why do guests always claim they are on a honeymoon? What on Luna is a pillow mint? These are the questions that keep me up at night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do elevators work? Why do guests always claim they are on a honeymoon? What on Luna is a pillow mint? These are the questions that keep me up at night.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: You have? How peculiar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have? How peculiar.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Not from you, from life! The future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not from you, from life! The future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Anywhere but the cup! I used to have to twirl about with my mouth open to catch the drips before they got into the equipment. Or drink it through a straw. But look at this! I can’t believe it’s all just staying in there. What would happen if I poured it on the ground?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anywhere but the cup! I used to have to twirl about with my mouth open to catch the drips before they got into the equipment. Or drink it through a straw. But look at this! I can’t believe it’s all just staying in there. What would happen if I poured it on the ground?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Well yes, but it only costs… you know, I have no idea of what coffee costs down here. What is it, twenty Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well yes, but it only costs… you know, I have no idea of what coffee costs down here. What is it, twenty Lims?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: There is? Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is? Alright.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Less?? I can see why my parents found this place so fascinating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Less?? I can see why my parents found this place so fascinating.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Perhaps. Tell me, would you care to meet for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps. Tell me, would you care to meet for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Indeed. Tell me, would you care to meet me for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. Tell me, would you care to meet me for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: If I were in space such a thought would be ludicrous! But here, yes, why not. I am asking you "out".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I were in space such a thought would be ludicrous! But here, yes, why not. I am asking you "out".

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Excellent. I look forward to conversing over our contained fluids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excellent. I look forward to conversing over our contained fluids.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: You're right, what a thought. Now I must get back to this "coffee".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right, what a thought. Now I must get back to this "coffee".

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Drinks, then. Until we meet again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Drinks, then. Until we meet again.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh, yes, now I remember. I wanted to see... Would you look at that? It’s in the cup!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, yes, now I remember. I wanted to see... Would you look at that? It’s in the cup!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Is that how you all take your coffee down here? I don't recall ordering such a thing...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that how you all take your coffee down here? I don't recall ordering such a thing...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry about your parents. How are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry about your parents. How are you doing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry about your parents. How are you doing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry about your parents. How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Uh, yep. I’ve got your coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh, yep. I’ve got your coffee?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Uh, yep. I’ve got your coffee?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Uh, yep. I’ve got your coffee?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: From?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: From?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean, I just found you so...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, I just found you so...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean, I just found you so...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean, I just found you so...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean running the hotel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean running the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe this coffee will help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe this coffee will help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where... else would it be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where... else would it be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’ll have wasted a perfectly good coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’ll have wasted a perfectly good coffee?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You’ll have wasted a perfectly good coffee?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You’ll have wasted a perfectly good coffee?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Less than that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Less than that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Plus there's a thirty Lim delivery charge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Plus there's a thirty Lim delivery charge.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. Plus there's a thirty Lim delivery charge.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. Plus there's a thirty Lim delivery charge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm joking. Just enjoy your coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm joking. Just enjoy your coffee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm joking. Just enjoy your coffee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm joking. Just enjoy your coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleasure doing business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure they'd be glad to see you here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure they'd be glad to see you here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure they'd be glad to see you here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure they'd be glad to see you here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, gotta run. Enjoy the coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, gotta run. Enjoy the coffee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, gotta run. Enjoy the coffee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, gotta run. Enjoy the coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you asking me out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you asking me out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: OK. Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks but no thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks but no thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just say "drinks".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just say "drinks".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dark Roast with a Tuna Fish Croissant?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dark Roast with a Tuna Fish Croissant?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Dark Roast with a Tuna Fish Croissant?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Dark Roast with a Tuna Fish Croissant?
